$note: Single source of truth for the Island action titles (substrate S3, second slice; added for iPhone Duo, D27). Apple's iPhone Duo guidance requires a title and a symbol for every toolbar item, because the system uses the title in the overflow menu and expanded forms. `title` is the user-facing label; `symbol` is the SF Symbol Phase 2 of the Duo plan renders on iOS (Android maps it to its own icon set). `desktop` names, per desktop file, the base label that file already carries for the same action — the guard verifies that literal still exists there (as a `title`/`aria-label` or `pillButton(...)` argument, allowing a trailing shortcut suffix such as ` (⌘T)`), so a desktop rename fails `copy:check` until the catalog and the mobile resources follow. An entry with `platforms` is omitted from the desktop guard and only emitted for the listed platforms.

actions.title: Tabs
actions.comment: The vertical tab-dots toolbar item on iPhone Duo (D27). Desktop has no single 'Tabs' control — its dots are individually labelled 'Switch to <title>' — so there is nothing to guard.
